item.title: Money operations take keyword-only idempotency_key
item.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it first, before any state validation: scan `ledgerly.audit.events(<event>)` for a matching key and return the original record without reapplying. Pass `idempotency_key` into the `audit.record(...)` call.

review_comments: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept an optional keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` (callers without a key keep working). Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write. Introduced after the double-refund incident INC-204.
